title: Fix VS Code Compose Dev Environment
description: Investigate and fix why the Compose development workflow does not work in VS Code. Inspect workspace settings, MCP configuration, hooks, devcontainer, launch/tasks, and root/package scripts. Implement the necessary changes in existing files and validate the relevant dev workflow.
summary: Fixed VS Code launch-task wiring for Compose and repo extension development. Repaired invalid preLaunchTask labels in .vscode/launch.json, corrected the repo VS Code dev task target in .vscode/tasks.json, and changed compose/vscode dev watching to use a shell-based parallel Vite command without an undeclared concurrently dependency.
